sources.cite: Microsoft Learn, 'Configure Start VM on Connect' (Azure Virtual Desktop)
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: assign the 'Desktop Virtualization Power On Contributor' role to the Azure Virtual Desktop service principal (or a managed identity assigned to the host pool) 'at the appropriate scope containing the host pool and session host VMs'; lower scopes are fine 'as long as the assignment scope contains the target session host VMs'; for personal host pools it 'only powers on an existing session host VM that is already assigned'; connecting directly to a VM by IP or name does not start it. The connection error text users see in a personal pool and the activity-log wording are from memory (to verify).
